title: Declare Core distribution intent and document the breaking Ensure signature
outcome: Core's intended distribution and API compatibility policy is explicit, and direct callers can discover the Ensure migration.
acceptance: The five-argument to explicit-mode six-argument WorktreeIndexer.Ensure migration is documented in the appropriate Core API/release surface, and the owner decides whether Core is intended to be separately packaged.

completion.summary: Owner chose one Phoenix MCP/CLI product. Both engine libraries explicitly non-packable; distribution policy and breaking Ensure migration documented. Full gate and new dual review CLEAN; delivered in worktree, not yet committed/pushed.
